prompt:
Desktop web UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape, of Marketo's full program page. Same visual world as the reference: warm newsprint paper #e6d8c6 with fiber grain, carbon ink #040303, extra-condensed athletic gothic for names, Barlow Condensed agate labels, 3px solid black rules, square-cut everything, no rounded corners, no shadows, no glass. BTC silks red #e42c22 square; ETH silks blue #0756d0 square. Purse green #085324 for money only. This is a designed website, not a racetrack photo, not a poster.

The reference supplies palette, type, rules, silks squares, and stamp character. Do NOT copy the reference layout (no giant selected call as the whole first viewport).

STRUCTURE: (1) Thin masthead ~8% height: MARKETO left; weekday date; dreamDEX line; EN/ID; ENTER A HORSE. (2) CONDITIONS OF RACE invert chips under a 3px rule. (3) The page is a FULL-WIDTH overnight of horse rows (original sheet): program number, silks, name, age, created, PnL, TVL ruled bar, ACTIVE/SCRATCHED. Rows for WARDEN, KITE, REDLINE, ASH, GLAZE, HOLLOW. Figures carry tiny inverted SYNTHETIC tags. (4) A 55% Hot Sheet carbon (#f3eadc wash) is DROPPED onto the lower-right of the SAME sheet, sharing the 3px rules, not a floating modal, not a centered dialog: huge condensed WARDEN, BTC silks, past-performance rows, TVL filling toward max, last backer line DEPOSIT or WITHDRAW, amount field, green rubber-stamp DEPOSIT. The overnight rows peek out from under the carbon on the left and top so you still see the original list.

Visitor job (compare the overnight, then stamp the carbon) must be readable from the image alone. No neon, no Inter, no fake press.
